description: This file defines the EmployeeLicenseDecorator class which provides additional methods and behaviors for the EmployeeLicense entity, including setting related employee and license entities by ID, and formatting license date fields.

classes.name: EmployeeLicenseDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class for EmployeeLicense entity providing utility methods for setting related entities and formatting dates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with an EmployeeLicense entity.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee entity on the license using an employee number.

methods.name: setLicenseByLicenseId
methods.description: Sets the License entity on the license using a license ID.

methods.name: getLicenseIssuedDate
methods.description: Returns the license issued date formatted as a string.

methods.name: getLicenseExpiryDate
methods.description: Returns the license expiry date formatted as a string.
